q: I know people will say you’re the parent just put them on her, but she’s literally hysterically screaming and doesn’t stop and I don’t want to be that person in public with a screaming child if all I have to do is take the shoes off and she’s fine.

q: How long do I wait before trying commando in shorts again? The book doesn’t go into this at all.

Daycare said they would (begrudgingly) be willing to try underwear with her, but if there’s too many accidents she would have to be put in pull-ups.

q: We took a long weekend and went back to the basics. Naked from the waist down. […] No timers, no us telling her its time to go potty. Once she was done peeing we would say before you go back to playing we need to clean up your pee. Make her do all the cleaning, make it long and boring.
